# Relocation and Remote Work Policy

## Relocation Eligibility

Full-time employees relocating for a company-requested role change may receive up to $7,500 after manager and HRBP approval.

## Distance Rule

The new worksite must be at least 50 miles from the prior assigned office.

## Receipts

Temporary lodging and moving invoices require receipts within 30 days.

## Remote Exception

Remote work outside the assigned state requires security training within the last 12 months and manager approval.
